description: HPWREN FIgLib wildfire camera sequences (imagery courtesy of HPWREN, https://www.hpwren.ucsd.edu/), one frame per minute: 12-frame windows entirely before the first visible plume (smoke 0) and starting at least 60 s after it (smoke 1); fog is not annotated (unknown). Splits are camera-disjoint by camera mount; the far-field render ranges were set from image statistics of the train split only (no labels). Masks from the built-in fallback detector; the plumes are early, small and often distant. Only the test_iid cameras (the split Stage B reports on).
name: figlib (test_iid cameras)
stage_b: not run (no training or recalibration on real data); evaluation.json real status unchanged

timing_unchecked.note: no feature_meta.timing in the FeatureSet: predict's frame-timing check could not run
